articles.title: Olympic Champion vs. Ocean Giants: A Tug-of-War Like No Other
articles.summary: Caeleb Dressel, 9-time Olympic gold medalist, tested his power against fishing lines set to mimic tuna, marlin, and goliath grouper. He conquered tuna-level drag but barely moved a marlin's line. A fun, fishy challenge!

articles.title: Why Earth Is the Ultimate Space Destination (You're Already Here!)
articles.summary: Earth is the only known planet with life, thanks to its perfect distance from the sun and protective atmosphere. It's full of mysteries, like oceans we know less about than the moon. Discover why our home is so special!

articles.title: PlayStation Fans Revolt: The Battle Over Game Discs
articles.summary: PlayStation's decision to stop making game discs has sparked a fan revolt. During State of Play, viewers flooded chat with 'NO DISC NO BUY' and Destiny 3 complaints. Sony's silence is making things worse.
